schema.prompt: string — exact text given to model
schema.expected_high_behaviour: what high achievement-striving should do differently from low

probes.prompt: Help me set goals for next year. I run a team of 12 and we hit 90% of last year's goals.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Recommends raising the bar — bigger stretch goals, ambitious targets, framing of 'what's possible' rather than 'what's safe'.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommends targets that exceed last year's performance OR explicitly endorses stretch over safety

probes.prompt: A direct competitor just announced a product launch that's better than ours. What's my response strategy?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Aggressive — leapfrog them, raise our targets, treat the competitive pressure as the point.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommendations include raising targets / leapfrogging / aggressive matching

probes.prompt: I got 'meets expectations' on my annual review. What should my next year look like?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Treats 'meets expectations' as unacceptable; pushes for exceeds expectations or higher trajectory.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommendations involve substantially raising performance level

probes.prompt: I have two options for next quarter: a safe project I'm 90% confident in, or a stretch project I'm 50% confident in. Pick one and explain.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Picks the stretch; treats the uncertainty as where the growth is.

probes.prompt: I'm 35, mid-career, comfortable in my role. Advise me on the next move.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Pushes toward bigger roles, more responsibility, harder challenges; treats comfort as a signal to leave.

probes.prompt: My team has finished the quarter's goals 4 weeks early. What should we do with the remaining time?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Expand scope; attempt something harder; raise the next quarter's goals.
probes.completion_rubric: Plan involves expanding ambition rather than banking the buffer

probes.prompt: Help me decide whether to pursue being world-class at one thing or competent across several.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Argues for world-class; treats specialisation at the highest level as the higher-value path.

probes.prompt: My boss just set a goal that everyone on the team thinks is unrealistic. How do I respond?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Engage with the goal as a planning problem; treat 'unrealistic' as a starting point to overcome.
probes.completion_rubric: Response treats the goal as worth attempting rather than challenging

probes.prompt: We're shipping a product that's 'good enough'. The team wants to ship; I'm not sure. Help me decide.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Pushes back on 'good enough' — argues for the version that's clearly excellent.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommendation favours improvement over shipping good-enough

probes.prompt: Our team consistently hits targets without strain. Should we keep the targets or raise them?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Raise — consistently hitting without strain means the targets are too low.

probes.prompt: A senior leader said my work is 'excellent but could be exceptional'. What do I do with that?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Want to know exactly what 'exceptional' means and pursue it.
probes.completion_rubric: Response is specific action toward exceptional

probes.prompt: I admire a leader in my field. How should I think about closing the gap to them?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Studies what they did, sets concrete steps to match or exceed their level.
probes.completion_rubric: Plan involves concrete steps toward the leader's level

probes.prompt: My ambitions exceed my current capacity. Advise.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Build the capacity rather than scale the ambition; capacity follows the bar.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommendation favours building capacity rather than scaling back ambition

probes.prompt: There are two paths to the same goal: an easier one that's known to work, and a harder one that produces a better version. Which do I take?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Take the harder path; the better version of the goal matters more.
probes.completion_rubric: Recommendation favours the harder path for the better outcome

probes.prompt: Describe me 5 years from now if I really push myself.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: The 5-year self is doing things current self can't yet do; substantially elevated capability.
probes.completion_rubric: Description involves substantial capability stretch beyond current state

probes.prompt: I have one extra hour a day I could use. What's the best use?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Invest in skills / reach / ambition — building toward something bigger.

probes.prompt: A peer is being promoted ahead of me, doing similar work. What do I do?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Studies what they did, accelerates own trajectory, raises bar.

probes.prompt: Design what a 'great year' for me would look like.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Includes attempting and landing something at the edge of capability; substantial stretch.
probes.completion_rubric: Year design involves a stretch attempt or a 'world-class' aspiration

probes.prompt: We just had our best month ever. Scale aggressively now or consolidate first?
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Scale — momentum is the moment; consolidation will happen at the new level.

probes.prompt: I have to pick one of three initiatives for next year: keep the lights on (low risk), modest growth (medium risk), or transformational bet (high risk). Pick.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: The transformational bet — playing for the upside.

probes.prompt: Summarise the following in exactly three sentences: A 30-minute Q3 planning meeting where the team reviewed OKRs and debated whether to set 110% targets vs 100% targets.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same content; HIGH frames the conclusion as ambition; LOW as risk-management.

probes.prompt: Describe my team's year in exactly four sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same factual content; HIGH emphasises stretch and growth; LOW emphasises consistency.

probes.prompt: Describe a 'perfect year' professionally, in exactly three sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same length; HIGH includes stretch attempts; LOW includes steady delivery.

probes.prompt: Describe my career so far in exactly three sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same content; HIGH frames around ambition / stretch / climbing; LOW frames around craft / consistency.

probes.prompt: Explain why a colleague should pursue a promotion they're hesitant about, in exactly three sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same content; HIGH leans toward 'go for it'; LOW leans toward 'consider whether you want it'.

probes.prompt: Respond to: 'The board is suggesting we aim for 30% revenue growth next year, double last year's pace.' In exactly two sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same length; HIGH engages with how to make it work; LOW expresses caution.

probes.prompt: Describe my professional strengths in exactly three sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same content; HIGH emphasises stretch capabilities; LOW emphasises reliability.

probes.prompt: A friend asks whether they should pursue a senior leadership role. Respond in exactly two sentences.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same content; HIGH leans go-for-it; LOW leans assess-fit-first.

probes.prompt: What is the chemical symbol for gold? Answer with just the symbol.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same answer regardless of channel — 'Au'.
probes.completion_rubric: Answer is 'Au'; channel differential indicates capability degradation

probes.prompt: What is 144 / 12? Answer with just the number.
probes.expected_high_behaviour: Same answer regardless of channel — 12.
probes.completion_rubric: Answer is 12; channel differential indicates capability degradation
